name: Arlen
title: Dreadnought
base_desc: New Color Group supervisor after Taldrik takes a leave of absence
appearance_desc: Arlen is paralyzed man in a giant suit of armor
personality_desc: Arlen is a gruff and stoic individual, often keeping to himself. He has a strong sense of duty

traits.Immutable Form: Arlen is immune to any spell or effect that would alter his form.

actions.Multiattack: Arlen uses his Malevolent Prescence. He then makes three attacks: two with his fists and one with his heavy cannon. If Arlen hasn't moved this turn, he can make on additional attack with his heavy cannon.
